definitions: A regulation or principle governing conduct or procedure.
The period during which a particular monarch or government is in power.
Control of or dominion over an area or people.
A measuring strip, typically of wood or metal, marked in units.
A convention or standard way of doing something.
examples: During her rule, the country prospered.
The rule of law is essential.
He drew a line with a rule.
It's a good rule of thumb.
